title: MAGIC launches AIMM 2026, offers Rs 7 lakh in prizes for AI innovations
summary: Got an AI idea? MAGIC has opened applications for AIMM 2026, offering startups, MSMEs, students and researchers a chance to win Rs 7 lakh, with potential seed funding and incubation support.
llm_summary: MAGIC has launched the AIMM 2026 competition, inviting startups, MSMEs, students and researchers to submit AI‑driven ideas. Winners can share a total prize pool of ₹7 lakh, plus the chance to secure seed funding and incubation support to bring their innovations to market.
